snippet.title: Eldegarde - Official Launch Trailer 4K
snippet.description:
Welcome to Eldegarde. 

A sprawling online RPG set on a continent torn by war and magic. Delve into dungeons, craft legendary arms, and battle monsters or rival players across dangerous frontiers. Play solo or unite under a banner to forge your legacy.

See you in Eldegarde, launching January 21st 2026.
